text:
Maria: Anyone up for a quick 'stair summit' today? 20 floors up x2, meet by the service stairs (loading dock) at 3pm. Foam rolling after?
Jamal: I'm in. Can only do one round but I'll sprint the last 5 floors. :muscle:
Priya: Count me in. Did stairs + foam roll last week — my hamstrings said thank you. :sweat_smile:
Devin: I'll bring a yoga mat and a tiny speaker. Also happy to time splits and post a 1min clip to #lunch-plans-story if that's cool.
Kaylee: Make it a mini-race? Loser buys kombucha. :grin:
Ben: I'm benched by physio (long story) but will cheer and bring cold brew for after. :coffee:
Maria: Love the kombucha stakes. OK meet 3:05 at the stairs, quick warmup then 20 floors up, jog down. No headphones so we can hear callers.
Priya: Optional ankle mobility at the top for anyone interested. Warmup I do: `3x 30s calf raises, 10 air squats, 30s hip openers`.
Devin: If anyone wants lap times I'll shout splits and log them. Great for tracking progress.
Kaylee: Sweet. See you all. @Ben you can be official judge/photographer. :camera_with_flash:
Ben: :thumbsup: I'll hold kombucha/coffee & play referee. Good luck, losers. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
